crossRefs.note: I love you, Yahweh, my strength.
Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.
and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, with all the soul, and with all the strength, and…
He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked…
We love him, because he first loved us.
By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.
For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.
In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came…
As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions…
Oh love Yahweh, all you his saints! Yahweh preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.
Oh magnify Yahweh with me. Let’s exalt his name together.
I sought Yahweh, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.
I waited patiently for Yahweh. He turned to me, and heard my cry.
But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.
Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.
For Yahweh hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.
Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify…
She said, “Oh, my lord, as your soul lives, my lord, I am the woman who stood by you here, praying to Yahweh.
Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

translations.web: I love Yahweh, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.
translations.bsb: I love the LORD, for He has heard my voice— my appeal for mercy.
translations.kjv: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications.
translations.asv: I love Jehovah, because he heareth My voice and my supplications.
